tile.name: MQTT explorer
tile.desc: Live MQTT topics and messages from the broker of the box

addon.title: MQTT explorer
addon.summary: A page that subscribes to the MQTT broker of the box (install.sh --with-mqtt). It lists the topics as messages arrive. It shows the number, the size and the age of the messages. It shows the last messages of each topic as JSON, text or hex. It shows Meshtastic encrypted packets as traffic, not as content. The page only subscribes. It never publishes. It uses about 20 KB of storage. It adds no server process on the box.
addon.consent: This downloads the MQTT explorer page of Irate-Box from github.com/NomDeTom/irate-box, at the commit that this hub pins. The hub serves it to the visitors that you let open it. The page can connect to the broker of the box at /mqtt only. It can read the topic prefix msh/#. Every visitor who can open the page sees the topics and the traffic of the broker. Add the MQTT explorer?
